by_text.Recorded as not feasible: the only Korea: Recorded as not feasible: the only Korean record is a 2007-2010 pilot that reared wild-caught juveniles in land tanks; no fish reached market size, the planned offshore-cage grow-out was never stocked, and the economic analysis found NPV < 0.
